A '''Nova processing center''' was a resource drop off point for [[Labor droid/Legends|labor droids]] or other laborers harvesting [[Nova crystal/Legends|nova crystals]] from nova deposits.

==Behind the scenes==
Nova Processing Centers serve as resource drop-off buildings in the [[2001]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: Galactic Battlegrounds]]'' and its [[2002]] [[Star Wars: Galactic Battlegrounds: Clone Campaigns|expansion pack]].
